title: Chapter 180 Underground Rat Archer
content:
Chapter 180 Underground Rat Archer

The huge energy shock wave generated by the simultaneous explosion of ten explosive mosquitoes blew down all the platforms on the top of the demon castle.

The castle structure near the platform was damaged, and many buildings connected to the platform also collapsed.

The Zerg biological decomposition liquid splashed on the bricks and stones of the city wall, making a sizzling sound and corroding continuously.

The Zerg biological decomposition liquid fell on the demon army around and below the castle, and the skin of the demons with strong defense was instantly corroded and penetrated, and then the flesh and bones were eroded, causing damage to the demon army!

And those three-star flame demons disappeared, and were blown into light by the huge explosion caused by the self-explosion of the Zerg explosive mosquitoes.

From this, we can draw a conclusion that the three-star flame demons have greatly improved their fire control ability, attack distance and attack power, but their own defense ability has been greatly improved, and they cannot withstand the self-explosion attack of ten explosive mosquitoes.

The defense of the demons relies purely on the flesh, unlike the sacrifices and armies of the bear goblins, who also have various beliefs.

They are strong when they are strong, and weak when they are weak. There is no way to temporarily strengthen them.

"Good! The overall situation has been decided!"

Seeing that the biggest threat in the demon army was eliminated by the Zerg, Naga cheered loudly!

There was also a huge cheer from the Naga army. The Naga army, which had been fighting with the demons for a long time, knew the huge threat of the three-star flame demon. They saw with their own eyes that all the positions of the three-star flame demon were attacked violently. Even if they were well-trained elite troops, they couldn't help cheering!

Although they didn't know what attacked the three-star flame demon, as long as the three-star flame demon was gone, everyone's safety would be more guaranteed.

The morale of the Naga army increased instantly. If there is a numerical display, it should be close to the full value now.

It can be seen how good the effect of the Zerg explosive mosquito is. This explosive mosquito is really a killer that can reverse the situation on the battlefield.

The demon army, having lost an important three-star flame demon, became even crazier, with more troops pouring out of the castle, and organized dog demons also began to move out.

The Naga army lost the biggest threat of the three-star flame demon, and boldly carried out two rounds of siege weapon bombings against the gathering demon army, which made the dense demon army much sparser.

The demon army seemed to know that the attack times of the Naga siege weapons were limited, and regardless of casualties, they continued to send troops out of the city to fight a head-on decisive battle with the Naga army.

The Naga and the demons knew each other very well, and now that all their trump cards had been revealed, it was time to compete with their strength.

The Naga began to bless the combat troops with luck to enhance their combat power. Many melee troops followed the Zerg puppies, ready to join the battle at any time.

Luck is a magical thing. Wu Qing learned that armies that were not directly affiliated to each other could not bless each other with luck, and the Naga could not even bless the Zerg puppies.

Moreover, Wu Qing felt that it was a waste to use luck to enhance the army's combat power. From the perspective of the Zerg, it would be better to convert it into qi resources and produce more powerful troops instead of wasting it to enhance the state.

So Wu Qing never considered giving luck to the Zerg. Seeing the Naga tribe wasting luck like this, he wanted to tell Naga that the Zerg could send more soldiers. It would be better to give the wasted luck to the Zerg.

However, for the races in this world, consuming some luck and increasing the army's combat power is very cost-effective as long as they can win the battlefield.

This is the difference in looking at problems in different environments.

On the battlefield, the Zerg combat troops never bless luck, while the Naga tribe will bless the troops that are about to join the battle.

This war initiated by the Naga tribe has entered the stage of consumption.

...

Wu Qing's consciousness withdrew from host No. 3 and returned to host No. 1, focusing on the battlefield in the underground world.

The new situation in the underground world forced him to pay attention to the situation here first.

"There should be more than one layer of the underground world. We found that the evil eye and other races of soldiers came out of the underground passage of the ghoul territory!"

"Now in addition to the evil eye, the ghouls have found the underground ratmen we have dealt with before!"

"The underground ratmen who came this time are not ordinary, and they are very well-equipped!"

As soon as Wu Qing came over, the Queen of Insects told him about the situation here.

Through the sight of host No. 1, under the guidance of the Queen of Insects, Wu Qing saw a huge underground passage not far from the battlefield. There were underground ratmen troops fully armed like human armies coming out of the passage.

Near the underground passage were all tall, strong, and well-equipped underground ratmen archers. They looked no less imposing than the Naga warriors, and the longbows they were equipped with were even more exaggerated. At first glance, they were stronger and more professional than the longbows equipped by the Naga warriors.

Most of the people coming out of the underground passage are underground rat archers, and some are melee rat soldiers equipped with shields and broadswords. They are all over two meters tall and strong, and are completely different from the underground rats that attacked the Zerg territory last time.

These should be the real elite troops of the underground rats. As soon as they appeared, they gave the Zerg dragons a head start.

The underground rat archers have a range comparable to that of the Zerg hydralisks. The special metal arrows shot from their longbows have very strong penetrating ability.

They caught the Zerg dragons that wanted to attack the underground passage by surprise. Facing the rain of arrows, many Zerg dragons were severely injured.

The Queen of Zerg ordered the Zerg dragons to stay away from the underground passage area, allowing the army of the underground ratmen to pour out from this underground passage that led to nowhere.

"Is there another world under the underground world? Or are these underground passages just a way for the various races in the underground world to travel?"

"This underground ratman tribe has such a powerful army, and its foundation is not weaker than the big tribes in the local camp. This is another powerful enemy!"

These are the latest discoveries. For Wu Qing, it is still unclear whether these news are good or bad.

But it will be more difficult for the Zerg to harvest the underground world as easily as it is now. These arms of the underground ratmen, combined with the ghouls and evil eyes, will cost the Zerg a greater price if they want to win the battle.

The Queen ordered the Zerg Dragons to seize the time and continue to attack everywhere in the ghoul territory. With the increase of underground rat archers, the combat space of the Zerg Dragons will continue to shrink. If they want to attack again in the future, they will face more threats.

On the battlefield near the underground world barrier, the high-intensity battle between the Zerg and the ghouls has been continuing. The ghouls have lost a large number of ghouls in exchange for the continuous reduction of Zerg puppies.

The reduction of Zerg puppies was supplemented by Zerg puppies coming to reinforce from the Zerg territory, and the battlefield was maintained in a relatively balanced state.

This state was maintained until the underground rat archers arrived, and it was broken. The long-range attack of the underground rat archers allowed the Zerg puppies to experience the feeling of ghouls.

The armor-piercing heavy arrows specially made by the underground rat archers can also penetrate the shells of Zerg puppies under the projection of underground rat archers, which shows how powerful they are.

The Zerg puppies were attacked by both ghouls and underground ratmen archers, and casualties began to increase.

The Zerg Hydralisk phalanx moved forward, trying to bring the underground ratmen archers into range. When the Zerg biodecomposition fluid of the Zerg Hydralisk finally fell on the position of the underground ratmen archers, the arrows thrown by the underground ratmen archers also flew towards the Zerg Hydralisk.

After two rounds of mutual attack, both sides tacitly retreated a distance and left the opponent's range. The range of the Zerg Hydralisk was not much different from the range of the underground ratmen archers.

The Zerg Hydralisk was larger than the Zerg puppies, but their defense was limited compared to that of the Zerg puppies. They were also damaged by the underground ratmen archers. Fortunately, there were only two rounds of attacks and no casualties were caused.

The vital parts of the underground ratmen archers were covered with thick armor. The Zerg biodecomposition fluid splashed on them. These thick armor protections delayed the strong corrosive damage, giving them a chance to save themselves.

Many underground rat archers were injured, but not many were fatal.

In the first fight, both sides felt that they had met their match.

Wu Qing also saw with his own eyes how powerful the underground rat tribe was. These underground rat troops were like the elite troops of human countries. Except for the different races, other aspects were very similar.

Wu Qing saw with his own eyes a powerful organization composed of giant rats, and he felt it was a bit incredible.

The monkey tribe that Wu Qing had encountered before was at most dancing with a stick and learning the deployment of human troops, but they would not copy everything from human society.

The behavior, weapons and equipment, combat methods, etc. of these underground rats are all very similar to humans!

The one-star hydralisk, which was just over four meters tall, stood up and used its height advantage to spray armor-piercing spikes into the area of underground rat archers.

The Zerg Hydralisks sprayed armor-piercing spikes, which had a longer range. In addition, the attack was launched by stronger one-star Hydralisks with longer range. Nearly 3,000 Zerg armor-piercing spikes knocked down the underground ratmen archers on the ground, and many of them disappeared after falling to the ground.

The underground ratmen archers, even with excellent armor, could not defend against the armor-piercing spikes of the one-star Hydralisks.

The one-star Hydralisks continuously sprayed armor-piercing spikes, causing the underground ratmen archers to retreat continuously, and completely exited the attack range of the one-star Hydralisks before regaining their footing.

They no longer fired at the Zerg Hydralisks, but stood at this distance and launched projectile attacks on the Zerg Zerglings fighting in front of the battle to support the attack of the ghouls.

At this distance, the one-star Hydralisks had no way to deal with it, unless they mixed into the Zerg Zerglings to fight, but there was no need to attack the underground ratmen archers in this way, because the enemies were alive and they could continue to retreat.
